sentence: None of it is a document naming a patron, which puts this painting in the same evidentiary position as most works this famous: [what a museum's catalogue entry can and cannot establish](/famous-paintings/) turns out to matter more than the popular story built on top of it.

Ownership records overturning a settled attribution decades after the fact is not unique to this painting either; it is the same kind of documentary reversal that reshaped [who legally owned Gustav Klimt's most famous portraits](/gustav-klimt/): this one was settled by an inventory, that one by arbitration after a courtroom fight over jurisdiction.
